meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你搜索、评估并安装社区技能，扩展自身能力。它会先查排行榜，再运行命令行搜索，最后推荐可信技能并给出安装命令。
howto.when: 当你问“怎么做X”、“有没有X的技能”或表示想扩展Claude能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个能优化React性能的技能。
say.note: Claude会搜索相关技能并推荐。
Claude会查找并展示安装方式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you search, evaluate, and install community skills to extend its capabilities. It first checks the leaderboard, then runs CLI searches, and finally recommends trusted skills with install commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", or express interest in extending Claude's capabilities.

say_en.text: Find a skill to optimize React performance.
say_en.note: Claude will search and recommend relevant skills.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for writing changelogs?
say_en.note: Claude will look up and show installation instructions.
